name: Karoo Climber
description: Hammerhead Karoo OS CLIMBER HUD integrated directly into Biketerra's elevation profile panel with a tilted-slope grade indicator, live draft bar, climb SVG zoom, and 500m Karoo ticker.

settings.label: Climb detection sensitivity
settings.description: all (>=400m @ 3% or >=200m @ 6% punchy walls), medium (Medium & Large), large (Large Only).

settings.label: 500m upcoming grade strip
settings.description: Show the 500m upcoming gradient strip on all climbs, only long climbs (>=1 km), or off (header only).

settings.label: Approach pop-up distance (m)
settings.description: Distance before a climb base where CLIMBER opens and zooms.

settings.label: Zoom on-screen elevation graph
settings.description: Adjust Biketerra's elevation SVG viewBox to zoom onto the current climb and restore it afterward.

settings.label: Zoom padding before/after climb (m)
settings.description: Extra metres shown before the climb base and after the summit when zoomed.

settings.label: Replace Biketerra Grade & Draft dials
settings.description: Hide Biketerra's native Grade and Draft circles above the elevation graph while docked and display them inside Karoo Climber.

settings.label: Flat-road display
settings.description: When not near or on a climb: show a compact pill, keep full drawer open, or auto-hide.
